title: A Map of What Children Learn
summary: Marble's open taxonomy of 1,590 primary-school micro-topics, embedded and projected with latent-scope, to ask how much of the curriculum's structure the topic descriptions alone recover. A scrollytelling tour finds the subjects as continents, an age map shows the outline set by age 5 and filled in afterwards, and the prerequisite graph drawn on the map agrees with it except for a few soft edges that cross it.
